text: The real projective plane ℝP² can be defined as a HIT. Which best describes its constructors?
choices: base:ℝP², line:base=base, and surf:line = line⁻¹ (showing the loop is self-inverse as a path)
explanation: ℝP² = {base, line:base=base, surf:line=line⁻¹}. The relation surf:line=line⁻¹ captures the antipodal identification of S². This gives π₁(ℝP²)=ℤ/2ℤ.
